# Grabby

Grabby is a local-first content desk for the desktop. It captures any webpage as clean Markdown using a real Chrome browser, collects RSS feeds and platforms (X, Reddit, Xiaohongshu), and uses AI to score, summarize, categorize and turn everything into a daily briefing. Data is stored locally in SQLite. It also supports MCP (Model Context Protocol) for AI agent integration.

## Pages
- Home: https://grabby.eztoolab.com/
- Setup Guide: https://grabby.eztoolab.com/setup
- API Reference: https://grabby.eztoolab.com/api

## Key Features
- Extract any webpage to clean Markdown via real browser rendering, with login sessions preserved
- Full-page screenshots
- RSS / API / web source subscriptions with scheduled collection
- Platform collection for X, Reddit and Xiaohongshu
- AI scoring, categorization, summaries and tags
- Scheduled AI morning / evening daily briefings
- MCP protocol support for AI agents
- Self-contained Go desktop app with local SQLite storage
